headline: Bank of Thailand Launches Initiative to Integrate Informal Sector
summary: The Bank of Thailand increased policy efforts to transition informal businesses into the formal banking system to elevate productivity and increase credit accessibility.
why: Informal economic activity accounts for a substantial portion of employment in emerging markets, limiting tax receipts and access to commercial credit.

impacts.name: Thailand
impacts.why: Transitioning informal enterprises into the banking system expands credit markets and economic oversight.
